_comment: Model prices, kept out of the source because they change on Anthropic's schedule rather than this plugin's. Revise this file and rebuild; nothing in src/ needs touching. The two rate options in the plugin's preferences override everything here.
_updated: When these prices were last checked against Anthropic's pricing page. Shown to the user alongside any cost, so a figure from a stale table cannot pass for a current one.
_per: Prices are per this many tokens.
_rates: Matched by exact model id first, then by prefix, so a dated snapshot such as claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 resolves to its family. A model absent from this table reports its token counts and says nothing about money.
